questions.q: What is P responsible for in PID?
options: It pushes back based on the current error
It predicts motion from the stick
questions.explain: P reacts to the current deviation: the bigger the error, the stronger the correction right now.

questions.q: The drone is hovering, but the wind keeps pushing it and it doesn't return exactly to its spot. Which PID term is responsible for this?
questions.explain: I accumulates a constant error and adds effort until it disappears.

options: Enables air mode at zero throttle
questions.explain: D looks at the rate of change of the error and damps overshoot.

questions.q: Too much D usually gives you…
questions.explain: Hot motors and a “mushy” response: D amplifies high-frequency noise, the motors chase it and heat up.

options: A contribution straight from stick movement
questions.explain: FF reacts to the pilot's command before an error appears and speeds up the start of the move.

options: Hot motors with no visible oscillation
questions.explain: P overcorrects — the drone shakes at a high frequency.

questions.q: What is the D-term computed from in Betaflight?
questions.explain: From the filtered gyro: no derivative kick when the stick moves.

options: Doesn't accumulate I on sharp stick input
questions.explain: It pauses I accumulation during fast stick moves; otherwise I “carries through” after a flip.
